notes: kb/Work PB5426 landed. §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR4: "A description of a report group may consist of one, two, or three hierarchic levels": a. the first entry is format 1; b. "Both format 2 and format 3 entries may be immediately subordinate to a format 1 entry"; c. a format 2 entry has a format 3 entry immediately subordinate; d. format 3 entries are elementary. ReportSectionBinder#ScreenReportEntryFormats (85 only, COBOL2247) refuses a level-01 entry with format 3 clauses (a), a format 2 entry whose parent (the nearest earlier entry of a lower level) is not the level 01 entry (b: four levels, f1/f2/f2/f3), and a format 2 entry with no immediate format 3 child (c); #ScreenReportEntryClausePresence refuses PICTURE/COLUMN on a group (d). Witnesses: 1985-SR-XIII_3_9_3-4 and pb5426-four-hierarchic-levels (refused at 85); pb5426-four-hierarchic-levels-legal runs from 2002, which allows any depth (§2023:13.15.3 SR3).

next.reason: 1985 limits a report group to 'one, two, or three hierarchic levels' (format 1 at 01, format 2 at 02-48 over format 3 elementary entries). 2023 keeps the level-1 first entry (§2023:13.15.3 SR4, §2023:13.15.4 GR1) and elementary-only PICTURE/COLUMN/SOURCE/VALUE/SUM (§2023:13.15.3 SR11) but allows 'any integer from 1 through 49' with no depth cap (§2023:13.15.3 SR3), so deeper nesting refused in 1985 is accepted. Looser; no exception condition involved.
